doping_note: W: Griffith Joyner 10.49 (1988) still standing; wind-gauge dispute and era suspicion, never a positive test; GDR sprinters hold 1970s-80s marks. M: Ben Johnson 1987/88 marks rescinded; current men's WR Bolt 2009.

W: Kratochvílová (TCH) 1:53.28 (1983) — longest-standing individual athletics WR, doping-era suspicion. Koubek's 1930s marks rescinded (noted on page). M: Rudisha 1:40.91 (2012).

W: Wang Junxia (CHN) 8:06.11 (1993) still standing — Chinese 1993 distance records widely doubted. M: Ingebrigtsen 7:17.55 (2024).

W: Wang Junxia (CHN) 29:31.78 (1993) stood until 2016 — doubtful 1993 mark distorts the gap for 23 years. Current W: Chebet 28:54.14 (2024). Super-spike era affects both.

Pacing and super-shoe era (2017+) affect both sexes. W: Chepng'etich 2:09:56 (2024) is the listed WR; she was suspended in 2025 for a positive test on a later sample — re-verify record status. Kosgei 2:14:04 (2019).
W: Kostadinova (BUL) 2.09 (1987) stood until Mahuchikh 2.10 (2024) — era record. M: Sotomayor 2.45 (1993) still standing. Fosbury flop adoption (c.1968-78) affects both.
